from_speaker: cannot satisfactorily serve its current paying customer base
our_interpretation: Assess the service condition and existence of the financial expectation at the post date, rather than whether the projected cash burn ultimately occurred.
For the ongoing service condition, use March 14 through April 14, the latest month of daily service records before the post.
Satisfactorily serve means reliably provide paid access under ordinary usage conditions; it does not require satisfying unlimited demand.
The post hyperlinks the burn figure to a press report about 2026 projections, so use an estimated calendar-2026 net cash-burn scope. The year is contextual rather than explicit in the sentence.
Current infrastructure scale is a scope qualifier, not an unfulfilled conditional antecedent.
criteria.support_condition: Records establish material capacity-related failures affecting existing paying customers, and a matching report establishes that Anthropic expected approximately $14 billion of net cash burn for 2026 as of the post.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable service records establish adequate paid service despite the alleged constraints, or a matching contemporaneous financial record establishes a materially different cash-burn expectation.
